My projects demonstrate the application of statistical methods, data analysis and programming to practical and research problems. They cover exploratory analysis, statistical modelling, hypothesis testing and data visualisation using real-world datasets.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Statistical Analysis of Global Indicators

A collection of statistical investigations applying quantitative techniques to explore datasets, identify patterns and draw evidence-based conclusions.

**Focus:** Data cleaning, exploratory analysis, statistical modelling and visualisation.

**Tools:** R, RStudio and statistical methods.

**Report:** [View / Download Statistical Analysis Report](files/Statistical-Analysis-Using-R.pdf)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 2. Statistical Assessment of Water Service Providers in Kenya

An assessment of the operational, financial and service delivery performance of Kenyan water service providers, with particular attention to non-revenue water (NRW).

**Methods:** Descriptive statistics, data quality assessment, Pearson correlation and Wilcoxon rank-sum testing.

**Tools:** R, RStudio and ggplot2.

**Dataset:** [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Mwanja-collab/Kenya-Water-Performance) · [Zenodo record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23685035)

**Report:** [View / Download Water Performance Report](files/water_performance_report.pdf)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 3. Student Academic Performance Analysis

An investigation of factors associated with students' academic performance using the Mathematics Student Performance dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository. The analysis explores educational, demographic, family and lifestyle characteristics.

**Methods:** Exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, multiple linear regression, logistic regression, weighted logistic regression and model evaluation.

**Tools:** R, statistical modelling and data visualisation.

**Report:** [View / Download Research Report](files/Students_perfomance_report.pdf)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Retail Sales Performance Analysis

An in-depth investigation of retail sales and profitability, focusing on differences across business segments, products and countries. The project examines discount strategies and factors associated with profit performance.

**Methods:** Spearman correlation, Kruskal–Wallis testing, Dunn's post-hoc test with Holm adjustment, multiple linear regression and regression diagnostics using HC3 robust standard errors.

**Tools:** R, RStudio, Quarto and ggplot2.

**Report:** [View / Download Full PDF Report](Retail_Sales_Performance_Analysis.pdf)
:::
